documentation.content: Runbook row: API and WS process availability (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan). Responder: on-call API responder. An UptimeCheckConfig's check id is server-assigned at creation and unknowable when this file is authored, so this condition scopes by the checked host (resource.labels.host, substituted from --api-host at apply time, the same value infra/monitoring/uptime/chirp-api-health.json's own monitoredResource.labels.host carries) instead of a check id, and groups by metric.labels.check_id so each checker region's series stays distinct going into the fraction-true aggregation. This endpoint proves only process responsiveness; do not infer SQL, Redis or authenticated WS success from it. Initial, review after 7 days.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="uptime_url" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.host="{{API_HOST}}" AND metric.type="monitoring.googleapis.com/uptime_check/check_passed"
